# The Go functions over the complexity limits, one per line:
# <metric> <package directory> <function> <score>. Written by
# .github/scripts/go-complexity.sh --update; never edited by hand.
# cyclomatic (gocyclo): complexity above 15, higher is worse.
# cognitive (gocognit): complexity above 15, higher is worse.
# maintainability (maintidx): index below 20, lower is worse.
# The list may only shrink: CI fails when a function enters it or gets
# worse, and when one gets better until this file is written again.
# See CONTRIBUTING.md, "Complexity totals".
